name: ax-hi2-page-ax-v1
description: Acceptance contract for ax-hi2 (page.ax, the agent-first publish surface), minted BEFORE implementation per ADR-0008; v2 re-pins the persist boundary onto the ratified outcome algebra (ADR 0019, ax-37n.23). Contract fixed here: slugs are content-addressed (first 12 hex chars of sha256 of the raw request body), POST / returns JSON {url, slug}, GET /:slug content-negotiates (markdown default; ?format=html override), POST /:slug/persist answers 402 with a typed OFFER minted from declared pricing ({type: 'OFFER', id, title, price, checkoutUrl}; Stripe stub mode acceptable for local acceptance; live key is an owner-queue item), and the surface publishes llms.txt + a valid OpenAPI description. Byte-consistency, Accept-header negotiation, YAML-LD/persist-me body content, and the 429 rate limit are asserted in the repo's Worker seam tests (JSON-only assertions here). Run against a local dev server: node scripts/... then npx autonomous-qa verify http://127.0.0.1:8787 --spec docs/acceptance/ax-hi2.spec.json --expect-digest <pin>
